question.problem: A stack contains four cards, where each card is labeled $1$, $4$, $6$, or $9.$ If one card is randomly drawn, what is its expected value?
question.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Let $X$ be the label on a randomly drawn card. Then the support is $S=\{1,4,6,9\},$ and the corresponding probabilities are all $\frac{1}{4}:$

$$
f(1)=f(4)=f(6)=f(9)=\frac{1}{4}
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =1\cdot f(1)+4\cdot f(4)+6\cdot f(6)+9\cdot f(9) \\  & =1(\frac{1}{4})+4(\frac{1}{4})+6(\frac{1}{4})+9(\frac{1}{4}) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}+\frac{4}{4}+\frac{6}{4}+\frac{9}{4} \\  & =\frac{1+4+6+9}{4} \\  & =\frac{20}{4} \\  & =5\,.\end{aligned}
$$
